subject: [PATCH v3 07/12] mm/collapse: name the per-table scan reset for what it resets

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch without any objections or suggestions.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch renames the function collapse_control_init_scan() to collapse_scan_reset(), which accurately reflects its purpose of resetting what one scan accumulates: node load, allocation nodemask, and eligible-PTE bitmap.
